description: List the latest Norwegian government tenders and contract awards published on Doffin (Norway's national public-procurement / offentlige anskaffelser database) in the last N days, newest first. Great for monitoring fresh Norwegian anbud, new kunngjøringer, contract award results (tildelinger), and upcoming bid deadlines. Optionally narrow to one or more notice types (tender/competition, award/result, planning, ...) or a free-text query. Each hit gets a public doffin.no notice URL attached. Requires a free Doffin API key via _apiKey when a platform key is unavailable.

_apiKey.description: Doffin API subscription key (free — sign up at https://dof-notices-prod-api.developer.azure-api.net/). Injected automatically when the platform key is configured.

days.description: Lookback window in days (1-90). Default 7 — notices published in the last week.

limit.description: Number of hits to return (1-100). Default 10.

page.description: Results page for pagination. Default first page.

query.description: Optional free-text filter (Norwegian works best), e.g. "rammeavtale", "skole", "programvare".

type.description: Notice type filter — one value or an array; plain words work: "tender"/"competition" → COMPETITION, "award"/"result" → RESULT, "planning" → PLANNING, etc. Omit for all types.

name: doffin_recent
title: Doffin Recent
